import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.FiniteSupportTwistRank
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.SchematicSupport
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PullbackTensorOneSided
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.RigidPushforwardP1Sheaf

set_option autoImplicit false
universe u
open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
open scoped AlgebraicGeometry TensorProduct
noncomputable section

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

/- Prototype only. -/
theorem probe_finrank_globalSections_tensor_of_finite_support
    {K : Type u} [Field K] {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    {L F : Y.Modules} (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hfin : IsFinite (schematicSupportι F ≫ p))
    (hAnn : annihilator (tensorObj L F) = annihilator F) :
    (let α : K →+* Γ(Y, (⊤ : Y.Opens)) :=
      p.appTop.hom.comp ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).inv.hom)
     letI : Algebra K Γ(Y, (⊤ : Y.Opens)) := α.toAlgebra
     letI : Module K Γ(F, (⊤ : Y.Opens)) := Module.compHom _ α
     letI : Module K Γ(tensorObj L F, (⊤ : Y.Opens)) := Module.compHom _ α
     Module.finrank K Γ(tensorObj L F, (⊤ : Y.Opens)) =
       Module.finrank K Γ(F, (⊤ : Y.Opens))) := by
  dsimp
  let i := schematicSupportι F
  let D := schematicSupport F
  let N := (pullback i).obj F
  let pD := i ≫ p
  have hdesc : F ≅ (pushforward i).obj N := schematicSupportDescentIso F
  letI : IsFinite pD := hfin
  haveI : IsAffineHom i := by
    exact inferInstanceAs (IsAffineHom (annihilator F).subschemeι)
  haveI : IsAffineHom pD := IsFinite.toIsAffineHom
  haveI : N.IsQuasicoherent := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom i F inferInstance
  haveI : N.IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_pullback_schematicSupportι F inferInstance
  have hdim := finrank_globalSections_tensor_of_finite pD
      (hL.pullback i) (F := N)
  sorry

theorem probe_support_sections_finrank
    {K : Type u} [Field K] {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    {F : Y.Modules} [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hfin : IsFinite (schematicSupportι F ≫ p)) :
    (let α : K →+* Γ(Y, (⊤ : Y.Opens)) :=
      p.appTop.hom.comp ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).inv.hom)
     letI : Module K Γ(F, (⊤ : Y.Opens)) := Module.compHom _ α
     letI : Module K Γ((pullback (schematicSupportι F)).obj F,
        (⊤ : (schematicSupport F).Opens)) :=
       Module.compHom _ ((schematicSupportι F ≫ p).appTop.hom.comp
         ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).inv.hom))
     Module.finrank K Γ(F, (⊤ : Y.Opens)) =
       Module.finrank K Γ((pullback (schematicSupportι F)).obj F,
         (⊤ : (schematicSupport F).Opens))) := by
  dsimp
  let i := schematicSupportι F
  let N := (pullback i).obj F
  let pD := i ≫ p
  let αY : K →+* Γ(Y, (⊤ : Y.Opens)) :=
    p.appTop.hom.comp ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).inv.hom)
  let αD : K →+* Γ(schematicSupport F, (⊤ : (schematicSupport F).Opens)) :=
    pD.appTop.hom.comp ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).inv.hom)
  letI : Module K Γ(F, (⊤ : Y.Opens)) := Module.compHom _ αY
  letI : Module Γ(Y, (⊤ : Y.Opens)) Γ(N, (⊤ : (schematicSupport F).Opens)) :=
    Module.compHom _ i.appTop.hom
  letI : Module K Γ(N, (⊤ : (schematicSupport F).Opens)) := Module.compHom _ αD
  have hdesc : F ≅ (pushforward i).obj N := schematicSupportDescentIso F
  let γ : Γ(F, (⊤ : Y.Opens)) ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, (⊤ : Y.Opens))]
      Γ((pushforward i).obj N, (⊤ : Y.Opens)) :=
    ((toPresheafOfModules Y ⋙
      PresheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf.obj
        (Opposite.op (⊤ : Y.Opens))).mapIso hdesc).toLinearEquiv
  let eK : Γ(F, (⊤ : Y.Opens)) ≃ₗ[K]
      Γ(N, (⊤ : (schematicSupport F).Opens)) :=
    { toFun := fun z => γ z
      invFun := fun z => γ.symm z
      map_add' := γ.map_add
      map_smul' := by
        intro c z
        change γ (αY c • z) = αD c • γ z
        rw [γ.map_smul]
        congr 1
        change i.appTop.hom (αY c) = αD c
        dsimp [αY, αD, pD]
        rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
        rfl
      left_inv := γ.left_inv
      right_inv := by
        intro z
        exact γ.right_inv z }
  exact eK.finrank_eq

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
